title: Read prerequisite direction between planned features
preconditions: Use disposable planned features representing onboarding and server mode; this case describes planned dependency authoring and does not alter hosting work.

steps.action: When a supported feature-dependency authoring surface exists, record that onboarding depends on server mode and inspect both feature views.
steps.expected_result: A reader can identify server mode as the prerequisite and onboarding as the dependent feature.

expected_result: Read prerequisite direction between planned features.
